evals.name: regenerate-api-contract
evals.prompt: Annotate a CreateUser HTTP handler with swaggo comments for Swagger specification generation.
assertions: Documents request body payload with @Param linking to DTO struct.
Documents HTTP 201 Success response with returned model struct.

evals.name: document-error-responses
evals.prompt: Document error status codes (400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, 500 Internal Error) for an API handler in swaggo.
evals.expected_output: Annotations specifying @Failure 400, 404, 500 linking to AppError response struct.

evals.name: verify-swagger-sync
evals.prompt: Verify and regenerate swagger documentation after modifying HTTP endpoint route contracts.
evals.expected_output: Workflow running swag init -g cmd/server/main.go and verifying git diff on docs/.
assertions: Runs swag init targeting main entry point.
Verifies that generated swagger files are synchronized with code.
